about_the_game:
Beast Survivor is a time survival game that combines roguelite and auto chess elements. In the game, you need to constantly move, use your skills to defeat enemies, collect evolution stones to evolve, power up yourself, and enhance your skills, all while surviving in a land filled with beasts.

Skills:

The skills you possess will attack automatically, so you don’t have to worry about missing your attack timing. When you level up, you will get a chance to acquire a new skill or upgrade an existing one. If you are not satisfied with the drawn skill, you can use an [Evolution Stone] to redraw.

Evolution:

When you encounter mysterious statues in the game, you can choose to [Enhance] or [Evolve]. Enhancing primarily increases your attack power, while evolving fundamentally transforms your being into a more powerful species, boosting your vitality.

Evolution Stones:

  • Normal Evolution Stone (left): Randomly drops after defeating any monster.

  • Intermediate Evolution Stone (middle): Guaranteed to drop after defeating captain-level monsters (those with white borders).

  • Advanced Evolution Stone (right): Guaranteed to drop after defeating king-level monsters (those with colorful borders and are very large).

Using Evolution Stones is required for enhancing, evolving, and redrawing skills, so use them wisely. Be sure to pick them up whenever you see them on your journey!
